name: Erc20transfer
fix_description: Add an onlyOwner modifier or msg.sender check to the erc20TransferFrom function so that only authorized callers can execute transferFrom on behalf of addresses that approved this contract.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-call exploit against an obviously unsafe public token transfer helper, likely missing access control/authorization checks around transferFrom behavior. The PoC is extremely short and requires no DeFi primitives, flash loans, or multi-step protocol reasoning.
